output: screenferry-98c8fc0b

args.command:
bead create --title "Analyze root cause of agent crash signal -1" \
  --description "## Task

Analyze the diagnostic information gathered in the previous step to determine why the agent crashed with signal -1.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Review collected logs and diagnostics
- [ ] Determine if crash was due to OOM, resource limits, timeout, or external kill
- [ ] Check if this is a recurring pattern (search for similar signal -1 crashes)
- [ ] Identify the specific resource or condition that caused the termination
- [ ] Document findings in bead bf-3sytf notes or a dedicated analysis doc

## Notes

Signal -1 on agent processes often indicates:
- OOM killer (check dmesg for oom-killer)
- Resource cgroup limits (memory, CPU)
- External termination (manual kill, system restart)
- Watchdog timeout" \
  --priority 3 \
  --label split-child
args.description: Create child bead 2 for root cause analysis

output: screenferry-c810edb1

args.command:
bead create --title "Implement fix for agent crash condition" \
  --description "## Task

Based on the root cause analysis, implement a fix to prevent similar agent crashes in the future.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] If OOM: increase memory limits or add memory monitoring
- [ ] If timeout: increase timeout thresholds or optimize the task
- [ ] If resource limits: adjust cgroup or NEEDLE configuration
- [ ] If systemic: update NEEDLE/agent configuration with safer defaults
- [ ] Test the fix on a similar workload
- [ ] Document the change and reasoning

## Notes

Common fixes for signal -1 crashes:
- Increase MemoryMax in cgroup configuration
- Add pre-flight resource checks
- Implement graceful degradation for heavy tasks
- Add monitoring/alerting for resource pressure" \
  --priority 3 \
  --label split-child
args.description: Create child bead 3 for implementing fix

output: screenferry-5291d3cc

args.command:
bead create --title "Verify fix and close bead bf-3sytf" \
  --description "## Task

Verify that the fix prevents the crash and successfully complete the original bead bf-3sytf.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Retry bead bf-3sytf with the fix in place
- [ ] Monitor the agent execution for successful completion
- [ ] Confirm no signal -1 or similar crash occurs
- [ ] Close bead bf-3sytf with success notes
- [ ] Update this parent bead (bf-1mmo8) with resolution summary
- [ ] Document lessons learned to prevent future occurrences

## Notes

This is the final step - it validates the entire fix chain and closes the loop on the original crash." \
  --priority 3 \
  --label split-child
args.description: Create child bead 4 for verification and closure

output: screenferry-f7d051cf

- ✅ Parent depends on last child (screenferry-f7d051cf)
- ✅ All children have **split-child** label
